query: select te1_0.id,te1_0.route_id,te1_0.vehicle_id,o1_0.name,d1_0.name,r1_0.estimated_duration_minutes,v1_0.vehicle_type,v1_0.seat_capacity,o2_0.name,te1_0.departure_time,te1_0.arrival_time,te1_0.price,te1_0.available_seats,te1_0.status from trips te1_0 join routes r1_0 on r1_0.id=te1_0.route_id join locations o1_0 on o1_0.id=r1_0.origin_id join locations d1_0 on d1_0.id=r1_0.destination_id join vehicles v1_0 on v1_0.id=te1_0.vehicle_id join bus_operators o2_0 on o2_0.id=v1_0.operator_id where ($1=$8 or o1_0.id=$2) and ($3=$9 or d1_0.id=$4) and ($5=$10 or (te1_0.departure_time>=$6 and te1_0.departure_time<$7)) order by te1_0.departure_time,te1_0.id
